android.desc:
QR TIGER is a QR code scanner and generator that lets you read and create custom QR codes in seconds, right from your phone. Add your logo and brand colors, choose from dozens of QR code types, and edit or track your codes anytime, even after they're printed. Best of all, this app is ad-free!

KEY FEATURES

- Scan QR codes on the go
- Create static and dynamic QR codes: change the link or content anytime without reprinting
- Logo, colors, and frames: design QR codes that match your brand
- Wi-Fi QR code: let guests join your network with one scan, no password typing
- vCard and business card QR code: share your contact details instantly
- PDF and menu QR code: give customers documents and menus without paper
- Social media and multi-URL: link every profile or page from a single code
- Bulk QR code maker: generate many unique codes at once
- Scan tracking and analytics: see how many people scan, plus when and where

WHO IT'S FOR

- Marketers running print, packaging, and out-of-home campaigns
- Restaurants and cafés replacing printed menus
- Retail stores linking products to reviews, promos, and catalogs
- Event organizers sharing schedules, tickets, and registration pages
- Small business owners who want a professional QR code maker without a designer

Download QR TIGER and create your first QR code free.
